title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, full FT-900 report (September 2026 data)
source: EST: census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html, fetched direct 2026-09-05 — row reads 'U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services | November 4, 2026 | 8:30 AM | September 2026', internal id A202611040830, reference period A202609. Independently corroborated by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx (fetched direct 2026-09-05 from the current /-/media/Project/Atlanta/FRBA/Documents/cqer/researchcq/gdpnow/ path), whose 2026-11-04 10:00 row reads 'International trade (Full report), ISM Services'. Two primaries, and still filed estimate on two counts: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and no `confirmed` prefix covers a joint Census/BEA release (`CENSUS:` and `BEA:` each cover one publisher's own schedule page, not a co-published release). The 10:00 ET time is the Atlanta Fed's GDPNow posting slot, NOT the release time — the FT-900 releases at 08:30 ET
notes: THE Q3-CLOSING EDITION of this series: September data completes the quarter whose advance GDP estimate prints 2026-10-29 (gdp-q3-2026-advance-2026-10-29), and it is the attribution half of advance-economic-indicators-2026-10-28 exactly as 10-06 is for 09-30. Proposed during the intl-trade-full-report-2026-10-06 initial research (2026-09-05), which measured why a full-report edition earns a low impact and a ledger anyway: across 1,822 GDPNow vintage deltas the full report moves net exports a median 0.065pp against the advance report's 0.265pp and reverses more than half the advance move in only 5 of 45 pairs (11%), yet it is the only release carrying the end-use split — and capital goods has been the largest-magnitude m/m import end-use mover in 5 of the last 7 months against a 16.9% base rate over 71 months (binomial p=0.002). Unlike 10-06, this vintage is NOT solo: the Atlanta Fed bundles it with ISM Services, so a trade-line reading here carries an attribution caveat 10-06 does not. This edition is also the second leg of that ledger's regime kill switch (capital goods missing the top spot in BOTH the 10-06 and 11-04 reports ends the AI-hardware reading). Impact `low` is about MARKET impact, not information value: symbols: [], no house playbook is macro-keyed, and solo FT-900 release days are statistically indistinguishable from ordinary sessions on SPY gap and range (n=32, permutation p=0.40 / 0.86).
